title: Content validity gate for fetched evidence
problem_statement: Login walls, block pages, 404 bodies, JS shells, and raw PDF binary are stored as evidence and scored medium/high; claims then cite them.
user_or_researcher_impact: Users receive 'supported / high confidence' verdicts grounded in garbage — systematic misleading output.
reproduction_steps: run B6 pack: 4/5 adversarial probes accepted as evidence; PDF row tier high
root_cause: success = 'exception not thrown + non-empty body'; no http_status/content_type in row schema; quality score rewards length/https regardless of content validity
proposed_capability: record http_status + content_type per fetch; detect block/login/captcha/error-page patterns and binary payloads; set access_blocked/content_invalid; excluded invalid rows from claim matching and cap their quality tier; warn per row
alternatives_considered: drop junk rows entirely (loses failure observability — keep rows, flag them)
why_now: highest-frequency correctness failure across all benchmarks
acceptance_tests: B6 rerun: 5/5 probes flagged, 0 invalid rows cited by claims
B1 rerun: claim evidence_ids contain no platform-search/blocked rows
unit fixtures for login-wall/block/404/PDF bytes
operational_risks: false positives quarantining valid pages — mitigate with tier cap instead of drop

title: Run directory versioning — never overwrite silently
problem_statement: run_id = date+slug(topic); rerunning the same topic the same day silently destroys the previous 11-file bundle.
user_or_researcher_impact: Evidence bundles are destroyed by routine reruns; audit trail unreliable.
reproduction_steps: run same topic twice; pass-1 loop_record replaced
root_cause: run_id derivation has no uniqueness component
proposed_capability: append time or sequence suffix on collision (or refuse with --force); never overwrite an existing run dir
why_now: destroyed artifacts twice during this audit alone
acceptance_tests: running same topic twice yields two run dirs; original untouched
collision refusal test

title: Evidence ID uniqueness across sources
problem_statement: External JSONL rows keep imported evidence_ids; collide with generated ids (two ev-0001 in one run).
user_or_researcher_impact: Citations ambiguous; claim→evidence traceability broken on mixed runs.
root_cause: normalize_rows keeps pre-existing ids without registry/uniqueness check
proposed_capability: enforce run-scoped unique ids (namespace imports, e.g. ext-0001, or reassign + keep original as source_evidence_id)
alternatives_considered: reject colliding imports (hostile to valid exports)
why_now: provenance is the product's core promise
acceptance_tests: mixed-source run: all evidence_ids unique; original ids preserved in a separate field
collision unit test
operational_risks: downstream consumers relying on imported ids — keep original in metadata

title: Claim review integrity: validity-gated, conflict-aware verdicts
problem_statement: Keyword-bucket 'supported' verdicts count any row containing a keyword — incl. search shells echoing the query; conflict flags never adjust stance/confidence.
user_or_researcher_impact: Decision briefs carry action bias derived from noise; contested topics get one-sided confident stances.
reproduction_steps: B1: fundamental_leverage supported solely by YouTube homepage row; B3: conflict flag + unchanged confidence
root_cause: no validity/relevance filter before matching; confidence computed only from supported counts
proposed_capability: match only validity-passed rows (needs RB-001); exclude rows whose text is the echoed query; downgrade confidence when conflict flags overlap claim evidence; add 'insufficient_valid_evidence' verdict
alternatives_considered: full NLI entailment now (defer — needs LLM/deps decision)
why_now: claims are what downstream agents consume
acceptance_tests: B1 rerun: no claim cites invalid rows; stance != supported when only junk matches
B3 rerun: confidence lowered or stance conflicted when flag overlaps claims

title: Benchmark & regression eval harness
problem_statement: No eval exists; 127 tests are mocked; capability regressions invisible; improvement claims unprovable.
user_or_researcher_impact: Cannot demonstrate any fix actually helps; contributors fly blind.
proposed_capability: commit this audit's B1-B8 as a versioned benchmark suite: fixed adversarial fixtures (B6/B8 style, offline), live smoke set (B1/B2 style, optional), scored via the 02 rubric; run in CI on the offline subset
alternatives_considered: adopt external bench wholesale (BrowseComp-Plus corpus too heavy to start)
why_now: M0 gate: every other backlog item cites these as regression checks
acceptance_tests: make eval runs offline fixtures and emits scorecard json
documented threshold gates for PR acceptance
operational_risks: live-web subset flaky — separate from CI gate
license_or_reuse_notes: BrowseComp-Plus/DeepResearch Bench as design refs (check repo licenses before importing data)

title: Real web-search connector (key-free default)
problem_statement: No general web search: topics without pack seeds collect nothing or junk platform-shell pages.
user_or_researcher_impact: The engine cannot start on arbitrary topics — the core research use case.
root_cause: web_page needs explicit seeds; platform search pages are JS/bot-gated
proposed_capability: web_search connector: pluggable retriever interface (GPT Researcher pattern, Apache-2.0-compatible); default backend self-hosted SearXNG JSON API (no key) with optional Tavily/Exa/Brave adapters behind env-gated config; results feed web_page refetch (reuse target_discovery_refetch pattern runner.py:528)
why_now: single highest-leverage coverage gap; refetch machinery already exists
acceptance_tests: B4 rerun: jsoncanvas spec repo + adopters found without pack
B2 rerun: vllm-project/vllm and sgl-project/sglang in evidence
operational_risks: SearXNG instance availability; rate limits — bounded retries + backoff (RB-013)
license_or_reuse_notes: SearXNG AGPL — use as external service via API only; GPT Researcher retriever pattern Apache-2.0 OK to emulate

title: Execute decomposed queries (make query_plan real)
problem_statement: query_templates produce a queries list that no connector consumes; single verbatim topic string is the only query.
user_or_researcher_impact: Comparison/multi-facet questions collapse to one bad query (B2).
reproduction_steps: inspect any query_plan.json vs collection requests
root_cause: planner and collectors were never wired together
proposed_capability: map each planned query to search/github requests; add facet decomposition (entities, comparison sides — STORM multi-perspective pattern); cap total requests via existing depth budgets
alternatives_considered: LLM-side decomposition only (leaves engine broken standalone)
why_now: prerequisite to making RB-005 effective for complex questions
acceptance_tests: query_plan.queries count == executed search requests count in collection_execution
B2 rerun: per-project queries visible

title: GitHub intelligence: relevance ranking + license/release/maintenance
problem_statement: sort=updated surfaces 0-star noise; canonical repos absent; no license/release/contributor/archived fields despite being in the API payload engine already receives.
user_or_researcher_impact: GitHub surveys unusable for maintenance/license assessment.
reproduction_steps: B5: 6/12 rows ≤2 stars; gpt-researcher absent for topical query
root_cause: hardcoded sort=updated; row builder discards license fields; single repo-search endpoint
proposed_capability: default best-match sort with stars/recency composite; include license.spdx_id, archived, pushed_at (already in payload); optional per-repo enrichment call for latest release + contributors when depth=audit
alternatives_considered: require gh auth (excludes users; note doctor must then check auth not just presence)
why_now: one-day fix for a benchmark-verified failure; also fixes doctor gh check (presence≠auth, found in Phase 3)
acceptance_tests: B5 rerun: gpt-researcher/storm/open_deep_research in top-12 with license fields populated
operational_risks: unauth rate limit 10 req/min on search — cache + backoff

title: Freshness: published_at extraction, as-of windows, staleness flags
problem_statement: No publication dates extracted; no freshness window; 3.5-month-old seeds support 'July 2026' answers unflagged.
user_or_researcher_impact: Time-sensitive research silently stale — worst for the finance pack the repo showcases.
reproduction_steps: B1 evidence.jsonl: published_at empty on all rows
root_cause: extraction never parses dates (meta tags, URL patterns, JSON-LD); no window concept in packs/checks
proposed_capability: extract published_at (og:article:published_time, JSON-LD, URL date patterns — engine already does X-snowflake); pack-level freshness_window_days; loop check flag stale rows; claim review weighs freshness
acceptance_tests: B1 rerun: TrendForce 2026-03-31 row flagged stale for 30-day window; loop_record has freshness check result

title: Engine-executed bounded repair loop
problem_statement: Feedback rules are advisory strings; all repair in benchmarks was operator-driven; failed_no_sources/zero-rows dead-end.
user_or_researcher_impact: Users must know engine internals to recover from routine failures.
reproduction_steps: B4 pass1 dead-ends with 6 suggestions and no action
root_cause: loop record is written after the single pass ends; no re-entry
proposed_capability: one bounded in-run repair pass: on no_sources → enable discovery tier; on zero/irrelevant rows → simplified+broadened query variants; record before/after in loop_record with repair_pass=true; hard cap 1 pass + no-progress detection
why_now: converts documented feedback_rules from prose to behavior; benchmark-proven need
acceptance_tests: B4 rerun: single run recovers to relevant evidence with repair recorded
no-progress: second identical failure stops with same_failure reason
operational_risks: hidden latency growth — expose repair in status

title: Content extraction upgrade: content-type aware, tables, PDFs, chunking
problem_statement: HTMLParser text join + 4000-char truncation; PDF bytes as text; tables flattened; boilerplate included.
user_or_researcher_impact: Evidence depth capped and dirty; downstream LLM analysis reads chrome/menus.
reproduction_steps: B8 wikipedia table row; B6 PDF row
proposed_capability: content-type dispatch (skip or pdftotext-optional for PDF); boilerplate removal (readability-style heuristics or optional trafilatura extra); preserve table rows as structured cells; chunk long pages with stable chunk ids instead of truncation
alternatives_considered: ship Crawl4AI as hard dep (breaks zero-dep stance; make optional extra)
acceptance_tests: B8 rerun: table row count preserved ≥ top-20 rows; PDF either extracted text or content_invalid flag
truncation replaced by ≥2 chunks on 100k-char page
operational_risks: optional deps complexity — keep stdlib fallback path
license_or_reuse_notes: Crawl4AI Apache-2.0 patterns OK; trafilatura GPL — check before adding

title: Relevance scoring & reranking
problem_statement: No topical relevance signal exists; form-based quality only; irrelevant rows rank equal to on-target ones.
user_or_researcher_impact: Evidence yield unmeasurable; noise floods depth budget.
reproduction_steps: B5 12 rows, ~0 on-target, avg quality unaffected
root_cause: quality_score conflates source form with topical fit
proposed_capability: separate relevance_score (query-term/entity overlap vs title+text, deterministic BM25-lite) recorded per row; rerank evidence preview; loop check for relevant-yield
why_now: makes yield measurable before any ML investment
acceptance_tests: B5 rerun: canonical repos outrank 0-star mentions given RB-007
relevance field present + tested
operational_risks: keyword relevance gamed by SEO text — combine with authority later

title: Network etiquette & resilience: backoff, per-host rate limit, robots policy, honest UA
problem_statement: Immediate retries, no backoff/jitter; no per-host rate limiting; UA spoofs Chrome; robots.txt ignored.
user_or_researcher_impact: Rate-limit bans and ethical/ToS exposure for a tool that markets auditability.
reproduction_steps: code inspection (no live abuse test run — by design)
proposed_capability: exponential backoff+jitter honoring Retry-After; per-host concurrency 1 + delay; robots.txt fetch/cache with explicit override flag + disclosure in artifacts; identify as research-engine UA by default
alternatives_considered: keep UA spoof (indefensible for an audit-focused tool)
why_now: cheap, protects users and the project's reputation
acceptance_tests: unit tests for backoff schedule and robots gate
artifacts record robots_policy per fetch
operational_risks: honest UA gets more blocks — pair with RB-001 so blocks are at least visible

title: Cache semantics + longitudinal diff
problem_statement: Cache keyed on run_date+depth (cross-day never hits; same-day may serve stale intraday data unmarked in evidence); no run-to-run diff.
user_or_researcher_impact: Longitudinal research programs unsupported; cached rows masquerade as fresh.
reproduction_steps: B7 two runs; inspect cache keys
root_cause: cache was built for intra-run dedup not research memory
proposed_capability: TTL-based cache keyed on connector+source (not date); cached_at surfaced into evidence rows; `research-engine diff <run1> <run2>` producing added/removed/changed evidence report
why_now: unlocks the roadmap's 'persistent loop memory' cheaply
acceptance_tests: cross-day rerun hits cache within TTL and marks rows cached
diff command test with fixture runs

title: Real conflict chains + confidence coupling
problem_statement: Conflict sets fire on query echoes; same row in both chains; confidence/stance ignore flags.
proposed_capability: exclude invalid/echo rows (RB-001); a row may join one side only (dominant polarity); require chain min-independent-domains; conflict presence caps confidence and sets stance=conflicted when chains balanced
why_now: differentiator: engine already flags — make flags mean something
acceptance_tests: B3 rerun: chains disjoint, ≥1 genuine opposing source or 'opposition_not_found' recorded; confidence capped
operational_risks: over-flagging — tune term sets per pack

title: Near-duplicate & source-family clustering
problem_statement: Exact URL/text-hash dedupe only; syndicated/mirrored content counts as corroboration.
reproduction_steps: code inspection; no natural dupes arose in benchmarks (small yields)
severity: P3-low today (yields small), grows with RB-005
proposed_capability: shingled minhash/simhash near-dup; domain-family grouping (same registrable domain = one family for corroboration counts)
acceptance_tests: fixture test: syndicated copies cluster; corroboration counts families not rows

title: Replay & run comparison tooling
problem_statement: Artifacts are complete but there is no tool to replay a run from its bundle or compare runs.
user_or_researcher_impact: Debugging and regression review are manual JSON spelunking.
proposed_capability: `research-engine replay <run_dir>` re-executes from recorded requests (cache-first); `research-engine show <run_dir>` human summary; pairs with RB-014 diff
acceptance_tests: replay of a fixture run reproduces row counts deterministically

title: Domain packs expansion + pack validation
problem_statement: 3 packs; generic pack empty; min_match_score=1 misroute risk; hardcoded dated seed URLs rot.
user_or_researcher_impact: Coverage narrow; routing fragile; seeds go stale (B1).
proposed_capability: pack schema validation + lint; seed URL liveness/freshness checks in doctor; raise default min_match_score; packs for papers (arXiv API), filings (EDGAR), news RSS — each an official public endpoint
alternatives_considered: auto-generated packs via LLM (quality risk; later)
why_now: after M1 discovery lands, packs become force multipliers
acceptance_tests: pack lint CI test; EDGAR/arXiv connectors return typed rows in fixtures

title: Engine-side append-only invocation journal
problem_statement: No machine-written record of CLI invocations exists; audit trails depend on operator diligence (observer F-1: reconstructed timestamps).
user_or_researcher_impact: Runs cannot be audited or sequenced reliably; this audit's own timeline suffered.
reproduction_steps: run CLI twice; no global journal exists anywhere
root_cause: never built; run_manifest is per-run and overwritable (RB-002)
proposed_capability: append-only runs/journal.jsonl written by the CLI itself: argv (redacted), start/end timestamps, run_dir, exit status
why_now: created from reconciliation; cheap; complements RB-002
acceptance_tests: two invocations produce two journal lines with monotonic machine timestamps; journal survives run-dir overwrite scenarios
